jobs.title: Director, Clinical Research- Benign Hematology
jobs.description: Overview   Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area.  This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases.   The successful candidate’s primary role will be one of the clinical study leads working on the plasminogen program transitioning from Phase 2 to Phase 3. The Director will report directly into the program clinical development strategy lead who provides the clinical research oversight of the program. The Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence of his/her clinical trial(s). This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. The Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & Quality Assurance teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. The Director will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.   Key Responsibilities   Be a subject matter expert for the relevant disease area(s) Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical program Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts towards global regulatory approvals Oversight of trial conduct and safety Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans. jobs.title: Work at Scarlet
jobs.description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About this application If you want to work at Scarlet but none of our current openings fits your experience, you can submit a general application here. Tell us what you are good at, what you could contribute and the kind of work you want to do. We'd love to hear from you. Backgrounds of interest We are particularly interested in hearing from people with: Professional or academic experience in a field related to Scarlet’s work A track record of applying skills from another industry to unfamiliar problems Experience in medical technology, life sciences or another regulated industry What happens next We will review your application against our current and planned openings. jobs.title: Copy of Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Company overview Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology. Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care. The role Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people. As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next. This is a senior delivery role. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities.
